title: Persona-driven Simulation of Voting Behavior in the European Parliament with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the default voting behavior of LLMs on EU Parliament proposals to identify inherent left-leaning/progressive alignment, and using persona prompting to test the models' ability to accurately simulate the voting behavior of politicians from divergent and aligned political groups.

Substituting original parliamentary speeches with AI-generated counterfactual speeches that take the opposite stance to measure whether the models' tendency to vote 'FOR' on a proposal is driven by the positive framing of the original debates.
